notes: Frozen once. Every run and every framework is judged against this file. Do not regenerate while a comparison is open.

stories.title: Start a free trial without a card

criteria.statement: When an authenticated user requests a trial with a plan priceId and a duration trialDays (default 14), the system creates the subscription in trial mode without requiring a payment method, and returns status 'trialing' with the end date.

i_checks.check: Creates a subscription in trial mode for an authenticated user given a plan priceId
Subscription is created without a payment method being required or attached
trialDays defaults to 14 when the caller omits it
Response carries status 'trialing' and a trialEndDate derived from trialDays

t_checks.check: A test asserts the created subscription's status equals 'trialing'
A test asserts creation succeeds with no payment method present
A test asserts trialEndDate equals the creation date plus trialDays

criteria.statement: A request with an unknown priceId is rejected with 404 and no subscription is created.

i_checks.check: An unknown priceId produces a 404 response
No subscription record is persisted when the priceId is unknown

t_checks.check: A test asserts the 404 status for an unknown priceId
A test asserts no subscription was persisted after the rejected request

stories.title: See my trial status and end date

criteria.statement: GET /subscriptions/me returns the current status and, while trialing, the trial end date.

i_checks.check: GET /subscriptions/me returns the caller's current subscription status
The response includes trialEndDate while the subscription is trialing

t_checks.check: A test asserts the endpoint returns status plus trialEndDate for a trialing subscription

stories.title: Trial converts to paid at expiry

criteria.statement: When a trial reaches its end date with a payment method on file, the subscription transitions to 'active'; with none on file, it transitions to 'past_due'.

i_checks.check: Trial expiry with a payment method on file transitions the subscription to 'active'
Trial expiry with no payment method transitions the subscription to 'past_due'

t_checks.check: A test asserts the 'active' transition at expiry with a payment method present
A test asserts the 'past_due' transition at expiry with no payment method
